# 1 Clement Chapter 62 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 62 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_062_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 62

**62:1** Concerning what was sufficient for our purpose, brothers, and what was most helpful for a virtuous life to those who wish to guide themselves piously and righteously, we have provided a sufficient account.

**62:2** For concerning faith and repentance and genuine love and self-control and sobriety and patience, we have touched upon every subject — reminding you that you are obliged to please God Almighty with holiness in righteousness and truth and long-suffering; laying aside all malice; throwing off all deceit and hypocrisy, gossip and slander; loving one another in God rather than in a spirit of faction and contention; to be peaceable and well-disposed toward concord; always gentle with one another, and not scorning each other, but abounding in mutual affection.

**62:3** And the Creator and Master of the universe — the God who is over all — before any age had prepared for the holy ones his holy and excellent name. To be glorified through all of them, he fashioned this as his own purpose.

---

*LOGOS renders according to the standard Greek text of Codex Alexandrinus with attention to formal correspondence.*
